segments.title: Alpacas make a funny sound!
segments.say: Mateo from Cusco, Peru, knows a funny alpaca sound. Can you guess it?

segments.title: What sound does an alpaca make?
segments.say: What sound does an alpaca make most? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Alpacas hum!
segments.source: Modern Farmer: the hum is their most common sound
segments.say: Hmmmm! Alpacas hum. It's their most common sound.

segments.title: They live in the Andes
segments.say: Alpacas live high in the Andes mountains of Peru.

segments.title: Can you hum like one?
segments.say: Now you try. Hum like an alpaca!
